ruleDefinitions.name: Old TLS1.0/TLS1.1 Protocol Version Enabled
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects applications or users re-enabling old TLS versions by setting the "Enabled" value to "1" for the "Protocols" registry key. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\SecurityProviders\\\\SCHANNEL\\\\Protocols\\\\TLS\\ 1\\\.0\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\SecurityProviders\\\\SCHANNEL\\\\Protocols\\\\TLS\\ 1\\\.1\\\\.*")) AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\Enabled$") AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)")
